posts.title: Exploring Better Character Animation
posts.summary: Keyframes, RIFE interpolation, optical flow, and video generation experiments for Sky.
paragraphs: We have been experimenting with animation workflows for Sky, our hooded feline wanderer, to find a better balance between painterly detail and smooth motion.

Our initial walking study used four distinct poses. RIFE interpolation helped make fabric and feather motion more continuous. Additional optical-flow frames sometimes improved flow, but also caused foot ghosting and silhouette distortions. More frames do not automatically mean better animation.

Next we are testing video-generated motion, more deliberate gait keyframes, and a common video-to-Atlas import path. These are experiments, not production-approved game sprites. The publicly playable Sky prototype remains explicitly labeled experimental.
